instruction: In src/_pytest/config/argparsing.py, make Argument.__repr__ cope with an Argument whose _action is not set yet. Right before the line "args: list[str] = []" add three lines: 'action = getattr(self, "_action", None)', 'if action is None:', and, indented one level deeper, 'return "Argument(<uninitialized>)"'. Then change the later test "if self._action.type:" to "if action.type:".
